description: React component 'ChartSection' that renders a radar and bar chart to display skill progress. It processes input skill data, computes progress metrics, and visualizes them using react-chartjs-2. Includes helper functions for data normalization and aggregation.

methods.name: clampProgress(value)
methods.description: Normalizes a progress value into the 0..100 range, handling NaN and Infinity.

methods.name: computeSkillProgressFromSubskills(subSkills)
methods.description: Calculates average progress across sub-skills, defaulting to 0 if input invalid.

methods.name: buildChartSeries(skills)
methods.description: Prepares labels and progress values for the chart from skills array.

methods.name: ChartSection({ title = "Progress Chart", subtitle = "Your average progress per skill (updates live as you adjust sub-skills).", skills = [], })

ctags.name: ChartSection
ctags.signature: ({ title = "Progress Chart", subtitle = "Your average progress per skill (updates live as you adjust sub-skills).", skills = [], })
